en: Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor inferior, an unwholesome, inferior state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor medium, an indeterminate, medium state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six under root, six under predominance; ... pe ... three under result; ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by an unwholesome and inferior state, a wholesome and superior state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six under root; ... pe ... three under repetition; ... pe ... three under result; ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.
